_note: Example connectors for a generic setup. Copy to a private file and bind each connector to the MCP server and tool your organisation uses. Workflows never name tools; they name connectors.

docs.read.notes: returns markdown; pass the doc id from ref

docs.write.notes: create a new DRAFT document, never overwrite

tasks.list.notes: include owner, due date, status, last comment

mail.search.notes: read bodies without marking as read

chat.draft.notes: lands in the compose box; the owner presses send
